clauses.reason: Terminated by express revocation. Executive Order 12553 of February 25, 1986 (51 FR 7237, Federal Register of March 3, 1986; held government printing) revokes the orders listed in its table, and any amendments thereto; its enacting provision has no stated effective date, so the first end is dated on signing, 1986-02-25 (a reading, disclosed for the reviewer). The Federal Register publication and filing dates are not effective dates. The table lists 12187, whose subject line describes providing for the base production control level for marginal properties. Sections 1-101 to 1-103 set, for pricing regulations under the Emergency Petroleum Allocation Act of 1973 and for months commencing after December 31, 1979, the base production control level for marginal properties at 20 percent of the old crude oil produced and sold from the property in 1978 (divided by 365 and multiplied by the days in the month), define marginal properties by the crude oil pricing regulations, and let the Secretary of Energy adopt conforming regulations. Executive Order 12209 of April 16, 1980 restated the order to read as follows (before: the 20 percent level applied to months commencing after December 31, 1979; after: it applies only to the months of January, February and March 1980); under owner ruling 2026-10-21 that is a strike-and-insert rewrite, the clause continues, amended, and the substance changed. Whether the authority of the Emergency Petroleum Allocation Act of 1973 lapsed before 1986 is not established from held sources (the statute text is not held), and such a lapse would be an unnamed instrument and a disclosed candidate only. Executive Order 12287 of January 28, 1981 (held Federal Register text jobs/fr-originals/data/full_run/texts/EO_12287.txt; not among this packet’s citable evidence) exempted all crude oil and refined petroleum products from the price and allocation controls adopted under that Act without naming this order; it is likewise a disclosed candidate earlier end and not an end, and it is not recorded as a later event. No earlier express end was found.
